t: Actualizing the AI Age: Engineering Context, Not Manifestos
s: This article reframes AI interactions from 'manifestos' to 'actualization engines,' emphasizing radical transparency through observable application state (server logs) and reproducible system design (Nix) as core philosophies for effective AI collaboration.
sub: Radical transparency via observable server logs for AI state awareness
Idempotent system design with Nix for reproducible environments
The evolving role of the 'Context Engineer' in AI collaboration
Engineering context over broad pronouncements for AI interaction
